During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an underworld '''restaurant''' specialized in taboo dishes, and sought to add the banned and potentially lethal [[Arbran lava snail]] to its menu.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|A Culinary Caution}}</ref>
